subject: [AWS CPPO] Reseller demo capacity & co-sell governance standup
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@resellco.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: [AWS CPPO] Reseller demo capacity & co-sell governance standup

Claire —

Thanks again for the productive intro last week. We're trying to lock the first operational checkpoint for the CPPO workflow so we can sequence demo capacity, entitlement mapping, and the DocuSign milestone. Proposed agenda for a short standup (30 minutes):

- Confirm demo dates & capacity (demo infra + number of seats)
- Review mutual action plan (MAP) responsibilities and timelines
- Entitlement mapping: SKU vs marketplace listing sync owner
- AWS approvals / partner team dependencies

Action items for you if possible before the standup: can you confirm target demo windows the reseller has available between Jul 6–15 and whether you need Redwood to provide a hosted demo instance or a containerized package? I attached a draft deployment timeline and a placeholder .ics for scheduling.

I've CC'd Vanessa to cover co-sell enablement & entitlement questions and Monica for billing/entitlement technical mapping. If AWS partner team needs to be present for approvals, copying in aws-partner-team now so we can gauge who should join.

Thanks — feel free to propose a 30-minute slot; we can also do separate smaller calls if entitlement mapping requires engineering time.

Best,
Ben Carter
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-ppo-draft-deployment-timeline.pdf, redwood-demo-scheduler.ics
From: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@resellco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [AWS CPPO] Reseller demo capacity & co-sell governance standup

Ben —

Thanks for the clear agenda. We can do Jul 8 or Jul 13 in the morning PT. For demo capacity: ResellCo can host a customer-facing demo on our staging tenant but would like Redwood to stand up a pre-seeded hosted instance for controlled feature demos (short-lived). We can support up to 3 concurrent demo seats on our side; if Redwood provides the hosted package we can do up to 6 simultaneous sessions.

A few quick asks from our ops lead:
- A short checklist of required AWS entitlements and Marketplace SKUs you expect to map (just names/IDs is fine)
- Any compliance artifacts we should attach to the Marketplace listing (SOC 2 cert version, data retention matrix)

I'll block Jul 8 09:30 PT for the standup tentatively (will confirm with my ops lead). Attached: our reseller demo runbook (internal).

Claire Zhang
Head of Partner Operations — ResellCo
Attachments: resellco-demo-runbook.pdf

Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [AWS CPPO] Reseller demo capacity & co-sell governance standup

Claire / Ben —

Appreciate the quick response. A couple clarifications on the MAP and the entitlement checklist:

1) Entitlement/SKU ownership: Redwood will publish the marketplace listing but we'd like ResellCo to own the customer-facing SKU mapping for downstream quoting. We'll provide a draft mapping template (SKU ID, listing SKU, Redwood internal product id).

2) AWS approvals: tagging aws-partner-team here — can the team confirm whether a technical review is required before the private offer is activated in the marketplace? If so, what artifacts are typically requested (certificate PDFs, architecture diagram, test plan)?

3) Demo hosting: Redwood can provision a short-lived hosted demo (region us-west-2) with pre-seeded example data and a per-session rate limit to avoid noisy e2e runs. We'll need ResellCo to confirm the number of customer seats and whether they want SSO enabled (SAML).

I attached a lightweight MAP snapshot for discussion. During the standup we should assign a single owner for each row so we can track DocuSign milestones.

Thanks — Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Partner Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-map-snapshot.xlsx

Claire / Ben —

Quick follow-up after reviewing the MAP draft: for billing and entitlement purposes we'll need the following from ResellCo prior to Marketplace activation:

- Legal entity name and billing contact (email + phone)
- AWS account ID(s) to map the entitlement to (if using reseller billing pass-through)
- A CSV of sample entitlements (columns: reseller_sku, marketplace_sku, customer_visible_name) — attached a starter: entitlement_matrix_v1.csv

Operational notes:
- If ResellCo wants Redwood to provide the hosted demo instances, we'll include a short usage invoice as part of the PPO milestone (we can credit that against first-month committed usage).
- For SSO, we support SAML and OIDC; if you want SAML please send metadata before Jul 6 so we can pre-configure test accounts.

I'll join the Jul 8 09:30 PT standup and bring a billing engineer as needed.

Best,
Monica Patel
Lead, Commercial Ops (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: entitlement_matrix_v1.csv
